text:
ashley: Quick preflight check — starting the cascade preflight for feature flag `cascade_v2`. Rolling canary to 1% on prod (us-west-2) now. Please post thumbs-up once your checks pass. TL;DR: LB routing, DB migration dry-run, observability, auth headers.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout started: `cascade_v2` -> 1% traffic on service `gateway` in us-west-2. Runbook: https://runbooks.internal/cascade_v2 (logs streaming to #releases-monitor).

liam: Checked LB routing — no 5xx spike on the canary slice. Saw a small latency bump ~+20ms p50->p95, acceptable. Ran a quick smoke with `curl -H 'x-feature:cascade_v2'` and got 200s. :white_check_mark:

sara_pm: Product QA doing a focused scenario on cart/checkout at 08:45. Will post any regressions. Please don't escalate rollout until I confirm. :eyes:

tony_ops: DB migration dry-run completed on staging (no schema locks seen). Requesting prod migration window at 09:15 UTC. Migration is backward-compatible; plan B is immediate abort and flag rollback.

maria_sre: Observability looks stable for first 10m. I set temporary alerts: error rate >0.5% OR latency P95 > 500ms to trigger an automated rollback. I'll keep the runbook on watch.

ashley: Ok — granting migration window. @tony_ops go ahead at 09:15. @liam please watch gateway logs; grep for `cascade_v2` tag. @maria_sre will monitor alerts. @sara_pm ping here if QA sees anything.

liam: Watching logs now. Using `kubectl logs -f` on the canary pods and grepping for `cascade_v2`. Bumped probe timeout to 5s just in case.

sara_pm: QA found one flaky path in discount computation — 1 failure reproducible. Repro steps pasted below:
```
POST /cart/apply
{
  "items": [{"id":"sku_123","qty":1}],
  "promo": "SAVE50",
  "user": {"loyalty": true}
}
```
Failure: discount appears as 0 instead of 50% in 1/10 runs. Assigning to @ashley.

ashley: I can reproduce locally. Small rounding edge-case when `price` is a string. Sending PR #4021 with a one-line parse fix. Will do a quick unit + integration run. If this persists we pause migration.

liam: Reviewing PR #4021 now — LGTM with one nit on a comment. Approving for hotfix. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Canary updated to 5% after successful checks and hotfix deployment. Metrics summary: latency baseline +12ms, error rate 0.02%. No rollback triggers so far.

maria_sre: No alerts triggered. Autoscaling behaved as expected, no noisy restarts. I removed the emergency hold.

ashley: Thanks team — recap: runbook ✅, migration scheduled & executed ✅, QA pass after hotfix ✅, canary moved to 5% ✅. I'll add a short note to release notes and close this thread after 1h if no regressions. Leaving monitoring window open. :sparkles:
